description.zh-CN: 关闭后插件仍保持启用，但所有 filter 直接放行。
description.en-US: When off, the plugin stays enabled but all filters pass through.

description.zh-CN: 每行一个关键词；也可用英文逗号分隔。以 # 开头的行视为注释。留空则不拦截。
description.en-US: One keyword per line, or comma-separated. Lines starting with # are comments. Empty list means no matches.

description.zh-CN: 「拒绝」直接阻止发布（422）。「强制标签」仅对主题生效：向 tagSlugs 追加下方标签；评论命中时仍拒绝。
description.en-US: Reject blocks publish (422). Force tag only applies to topics (appends force_tag); comments still reject.

description.zh-CN: mode=tag 时追加到主题 tagSlugs。标签须已存在且符合站点标签策略，否则宿主校验可能失败。
description.en-US: Appended to topic tagSlugs when mode=tag. Tag must exist and pass host tag policy.

description.zh-CN: 主题创建/编辑时是否扫描 title 字段。
description.en-US: Whether topic create/update filters scan the title field.

description.zh-CN: 是否扫描 content 字段（主题与评论）。
description.en-US: Whether to scan the content field (topics and comments).

description.zh-CN: 默认不区分大小写，便于英文关键词匹配。
description.en-US: Default is case-insensitive for easier English keyword matching.

label.zh-CN: 在帖子标题下显示徽章

description.zh-CN: 开启后，主题详情标题下方显示「内容策略」徽章并链到 /guidelines。默认关闭。保存后刷新帖子页即可生效，无需重新激活主题。
description.en-US: When on, shows a Content policy badge under the topic title linking to /guidelines. Off by default. After save, refresh the topic page — theme reactivation is not required.
